description: List the 12 user flows covered by the checklists (onboarding, forms, pricing, dashboard, empty states, checkout, settings, navigation, search, authentication, notifications, data tables) with the target metric of each. Returns id, name, description, metric target and the number of checklist items per phase. Use it to pick the id for get_flow, generate_checklist or get_flow_principles.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

name: list_flows
title: List user flows
